facts.fact: WHO's SCORE assessment summary, on data from 2013-2018, rates a standardised system of electronic data entry for aggregate reporting at district or comparable level as 'not there' in Mauritius, while rating completeness of reporting above 75% for public primary care facilities, public hospitals and private facilities; the last year of the data is used as the date.

WHO's SCORE assessment summary, on data from 2013-2018, rates as 'not there' a system of electronic capture of patient-level health data that is standardised and fully interoperable with the aggregate routine system, both in hospitals and in primary care facilities, and records 'no data' on a national unique patient identifier; the criterion is a standardised interoperable system, not any electronic record, and the last year of the data is used as the date.
facts.system: electronic capture of patient-level health data

facts.fact: WHO's SCORE assessment summary, on data from 2013-2018, rates a standardised and interoperable system of electronic capture of patient-level data in primary care health facilities as 'not there', with no count of facilities; the last year of the data is used as the date.
